description: Verify that Multi-instance Method Responses sourced from distinct per-instance UDP ports
approach:
[Objective]
Multi-instance Method Responses sourced from distinct per-instance UDP ports.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT offers service; tester sends a Method Request (or specific stimulus); the resulting wire response is verified against the spec property.

[Pass condition]
Response / behaviour matches the asserted property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: Two instances replied from distinct UDP ports — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer: No two-entry offer with distinct UDP ports within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response_from_instance_1: No Response from instance 1 UDP port 30502
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_response_from_instance_2: No Response from instance 2 UDP port 30504
